mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT smi.sys_menu_id FROM sys_tenant_service ts INNER JOIN sys_service_module_item smi ON ts.sys_service_id = smi.sys_service_id WHERE ts.sys_tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (ts.sys_tenant_service_valid_time IS NULL OR ts.sys_tenant_service_valid_time > CURDATE())

SELECT DISTINCT ts.sys_tenant_id FROM sys_tenant_service ts INNER JOIN sys_service_module_item smi ON ts.sys_service_id = smi.sys_service_id INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.sys_tenant_id = ts.sys_tenant_id WHERE smi.sys_menu_id = #{menuId} AND t.sys_tenant_delete = 0 AND (ts.sys_tenant_service_valid_time IS NULL OR ts.sys_tenant_service_valid_time > CURDATE())
